title: Scope observable spatial teacher architectures without building them
doing: Derive source-only parameter/MAC/storage estimates for canonical-grid pooled CNN and grid-token branches; specify exact-zero residual gates and raster information parity. No Torch/native import, architecture implementation or model execution.
expected: A pooled CNN should cost tens of thousands of parameters; flattening or appended-token attention costs more. Existing auxiliary rasters may expose visible information absent from capped arrays, so primary comparisons must separate representation from additional input.
actual: Source arithmetic gives321290 baseline parameters. Proposed2x2-pooled CNN adds62977; gated64-grid-token cross-attention adds171522. Global-pooled CNN adds38401, while flattening adds554497. Existing auxiliary raster includes pre-cap visible geometry and warning segments absent from the capped four arrays, requiring a separate information intervention. No architecture was built, model loaded, runtime profiled or game run.
why: Pooling keeps projection cost small. Spatial attention, exact warm-start gating and raster information parity determine costs beyond parameter counts. These are analytical estimates, not measured throughput or performance.
next_step: Await Taylor approval before source-only architecture/expert implementation. Keep primary same-input grid and later expanded-visible intervention separate; review exact-zero logits/value parity and resource gates before any runtime approval.

evidence.label: Analytical architecture cost and raster input-parity scope; no model built
